sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
for t in transitions[-7:]:
    a = t.action
    bf = t.before_frame; af = t.after_frame
    def barpos(f):
        for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
            if n['color']=='b':
                b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
                return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    def mpos(f):
        for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
            if n['color']=='M':
                b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
                return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    print(a, "bar", barpos(bf), "->", barpos(af), "M", mpos(bf), "->", mpos(af), "changed", t.result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
